name: Floating Marine Debris Acoustic Benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating deep learning methods for acoustic monitoring and extraction/detection of floating marine debris from audio recordings.
evaluation_method: F1 / precision-recall / mAP / AUC (F1 and mAP commonly used for detection tasks)
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark for marine acoustic monitoring with limited but growing interest from marine-science and bioacoustics communities.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; likely small and imbalanced class distributions, strong environmental noise and sensor variability, and labeling difficulty—all of which complicate benchmarking and generalization.
